title: TRINITY surface to LOCK rotational spectrum
summary: TRINITY surface to LOCK rotational spectrum through its existing scientific owner; registration validates the contract and does not imply molecular or experimental accuracy.
gates: Versioned TRINITY surface and selected basis are validated
Declared angular-momentum, memory, worker and eigensolver budgets are enforced
When supplied the immutable upstream chain ends with ORACLE, SMITH, GF, TRINITY
A spectrum requires an explicit dipole and records temperature and line units
coordinate_policy: Consume the versioned TRINITY LAM surface and its metric, tensor and symmetry metadata.
backend_policy: Use declared local numerical kernels and resource budgets. This protocol submits no implicit electronic-structure calculation.
